import io.xberg.crawlberg.*;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();
        var engineConfig = MAPPER.readValue("{\"bm25_query\":\"\",\"bm25_threshold\":0.1,\"content_filter\":\"bm25\",\"max_depth\":1}", CrawlConfig.class);
        var engine = io.xberg.crawlberg.Crawlberg.createEngine(engineConfig);
        String url = "https://example.com";
        var result = Crawlberg.crawl(engine, url);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
